verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Capacities in the MCP server role: an official MCP server (capacities-probe-3) that external clients connect to (capacities-docs-1, capacities-docs-17), and Chat Connectors that let ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and others reach a Capacities space (capacities-docs-3). Nothing shows Capacities' own AI assistant connecting to external MCP servers or using their tools. The axis applies to an AI-enabled notes app, so the absence of evidence is "none".
